Click the link in the bio/profile to download the PDF files! 📺✨ Learn Korean Phrases with K-Drama: 내일 봐 [nae·il bwa] / 내일 봐요 [nae·il bwa·yo] / 내일 봬요 [nae·il bwae·yo] Today's expressions are "내일 봐," "내일 봐요," and "내일 봬요," which all mean "See you tomorrow" in English. These phrases are commonly used when saying goodbye to someone you expect to meet again the next day. 📝 Breakdown 내일 [nae·il]: tomorrow 보다 [bo·da]: to see 봐 [bwa]: casual form of 보다 봐요 [bwa·yo]: polite form of 보다 봬요 [bwae·yo]: more polite form, shortened from "뵈어요" ✨ What's the difference? • 내일 봐 — Casual expression used with close friends, younger people, or family. • 내일 봐요 — Polite and friendly expression suitable for most everyday situations. • 내일 봬요 — More polite expression often used when speaking to someone older or in situations that require extra respect. Although all three expressions mean "See you tomorrow," choosing the right one depends on your relationship with the other person and the level of politeness you want to show. #mascara                                    Un mascara est un produit de maquillage destiné à être appliqué sur les cils afin de les allonger, les épaissir, les recourber et intensifier le regard. Il se présente généralement sous forme liquide ou crémeuse, contenu dans un tube avec une brosse applicatrice. Le mascara permet de donner plus de volume et de définition aux cils en les colorant, le plus souvent en noir, mais aussi en brun ou en couleurs plus originales. Selon sa formule et la forme de la brosse, il peut offrir différents effets : naturel, volumineux, allongeant ou recourbant. Facile à utiliser, il est un élément essentiel du maquillage des yeux, mais reste temporaire et s’enlève avec un démaquillant adapté.                     #lashes #prt #fyp #foryoupagе
